'''Nilloc''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who lived around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], and he served as a [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] for the [[Coalition]]. He was present in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Tolea Biqua]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Genarius]] when it was [[Battle of Tolea Biqua|attacked]] by the [[Cularin Militia]], and was paired with the [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Vegg]].
